paper.title: Chain of Spatial Thoughts: Modality-Agnostic Spatial Grounding for Vision Language Models
paper.abstract: Spatial understanding is fundamental to embodied intelligence, underpinning applications such as robotic manipulation, embodied navigation, and autonomous driving. Although recent vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance on spatial reasoning benchmarks, state-of-the-art approaches typically rely on additional spatial encoders or architectural modifications during inference, increasing computational cost. We introduce Space Tokens, a lightweight, architecture-agnostic fr

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是 VLM 空间推理能力的注入方式：如何让模型获得显式 3D 几何和物体级空间属性，同时不在推理时外挂 3D 重建编码器、几何连接器或额外空间模块。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要在统一表示和 latent token 监督。它不是单纯做空间 benchmark，而是把 3D 几何知识压到 VLM 的生成序列中，用保留词表位置对应的 hidden states 承载连续空间表示。这个思路和视觉 tokenizer、latent knowledge token、native multimodal mid-train 接口关系较近：外部专家模型只在训练阶段提供监督，推理阶段由原 VLM 内部表示承接知识。贡献量级偏方法型，不是大规模预训练 recipe，但对“如何把不可文本化的结构知识并入 LM token 流”有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Space Tokens。核心做法是预留一组特殊 token，但不使用它们的离散 token id 表达空间信息，而是取这些 token 生成位置的最后层 hidden states 作为连续空间向量。模型仍按自回归方式生成文本和空间 token，因此不需要改 Transformer 结构，也不需要在推理时调用额外 3D 模块。训练时，空间 token 接受两类监督：一类是 scene-level 3D geometry，把大型 3D reconstruction 模型产生的场景几何知识蒸馏进 VLM latent space；另一类是 object-centric spatial attributes，把 3D bounding box 的位置、朝向和尺寸编码进专用 latent token。与直接拼接深度图、点云 encoder 或几何 adapter 相比，这种方案把几何监督放在训练期，把推理期接口保持为普通 VLM token 流。代价是空间 token 的语义依赖监督质量，且连续表示需要额外 decoder 或 probe 才能被显式验证。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖空间推理、视觉问答和通用 VQA。文中报告 Space Tokens 在 VSI-Bench 上使 Qwen3-VL-8B 提升 4.3 分，使 SenseNova1.3 提升 1.3 分；在 object size 和 room size estimation 上也取得较强结果。更有信息量的部分不是单个分数，而是两个现象：第一，外部 3D 教师模型可以在训练后被移除，说明几何信号部分进入了 VLM 内部状态；第二，空间 token 可被解码回可解释 3D 模态，用于检查模型学到的是否是几何结构，而不只是 benchmark shortcut。摘要和给定正文没有完整列出各 benchmark 的绝对分数、训练数据规模和消融数值，因此这些部分需要读表确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Methodology 中空间 token 的定义、hidden state 抽取位置、scene-level 和 object-level 两类监督的具体 loss，以及是否在训练和推理阶段引入不同组件。实验部分优先看 VSI-Bench 的主表、object size / room size 估计表、空间 token 可视化或可解码验证图。消融需要关注三点：只用场景几何、只用物体 3D box、两者同时使用的差异；空间 token 数量和插入位置；通用 VQA 是否退化。这些决定它更像一个稳健的 latent token 接口，还是主要依赖特定空间 benchmark 的监督适配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to inject explicit 3D geometry and object-level spatial attributes into VLMs without adding reconstruction encoders, geometry adapters, or other inference-time spatial modules.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model pretraining is the representation interface. Space Tokens treat reserved token positions as carriers of continuous latent states, supervised by external geometric signals during training and used as native tokens at inference. This connects to visual tokenization, latent knowledge tokens, and multimodal mid-training: a teacher model supplies structured non-text information, while the deployed VLM keeps the same autoregressive interface. The contribution is methodological rather than a large-scale pretraining recipe, but it is useful for thinking about how non-linguistic structure can be folded into an LM token stream.
summary_en.technical_approach: Space Tokens reserve a subset of the vocabulary and let the VLM generate these tokens just like normal autoregressive tokens. Their discrete identities are not the main representation; the final-layer hidden states at these positions are used as continuous spatial embeddings. The training supervision has two branches. One distills scene-level 3D geometry from large 3D reconstruction models into the VLM latent space. The other encodes object-centric 3D bounding-box attributes, including position, orientation, and size, into dedicated spatial tokens. Compared with attaching depth, point-cloud, or geometry encoders, the heavy geometry model is only used during training. The trade-off is that the learned latent tokens depend on teacher quality and need decoders or probes for explicit verification.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers spatial reasoning, visual QA, and general VQA. The reported gains include +4.3 points on VSI-Bench for Qwen3-VL-8B and +1.3 points for SenseNova1.3. The method also reports strong results on object-size and room-size estimation. The more useful evidence is qualitative and diagnostic: the 3D teacher can be removed at inference, and the learned spatial states remain decodable into interpretable 3D modalities. The provided text does not expose the full score tables, data scale, or all ablation numbers, so those details should be checked directly in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the Methodology section: how spatial tokens are inserted, which hidden states are supervised, what losses are used for scene-level geometry and object-level boxes, and whether the training and inference graphs differ. In the experiments, read the VSI-Bench table, the object-size and room-size estimation results, and any visualization or decoding analysis of Space Tokens. The most important ablations are scene geometry only versus object boxes only, the number and placement of spatial tokens, and whether general VQA performance is preserved.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态预训练的空间能力注入可参考其蒸馏思路，重点看§3的Space Tokens设计和消融实验
recommendation.en: Reference for spatial ability injection in multimodal pretraining; focus on §3 Space Tokens design and ablation studies.

paper.title: Multi-View Relational Distillation for Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong image and video understanding, yet their visual-spatial representations remain geometrically fragile, leading to failures in spatial reasoning needed for embodied AI, robotics, and autonomous driving. Prior approaches to geometry grounding either fine-tune VLMs on spatial question answering, which can perpetuate spurious visual representations, or fuse features from large geometry-grounded vision models, which substantially increases model size

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在空间推理中几何表征脆弱的问题，尤其是多视角场景下对象关系和空间对应不稳定。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 表征蒸馏方法改进。它关注一个真实问题：直接引入几何模型特征会增加推理成本，直接特征蒸馏又可能破坏原有图文语义对齐。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Multi-View Relational Distillation，不直接匹配几何教师模型的特征，而是蒸馏跨视角 patch-wise cosine similarity。这样保留几何对应关系，同时减少对 VLM 原有视觉-文本对齐空间的扰动。
summary.experiments: 摘要称方法面向图像和视频理解中的空间推理，并与空间问答微调、几何特征融合、直接特征蒸馏等思路对比；未提供模型规模、数据规模和具体提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses fragile geometric representations in VLMs, especially unstable multi-view spatial correspondences needed for visual-spatial reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a representation distillation method for VLMs. The useful point is the trade-off: geometry-grounded teachers can help, but feature fusion increases inference cost and direct feature matching may damage vision-language alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Multi-View Relational Distillation, which distills patch-wise cosine similarity relations across views rather than matching teacher features directly. The goal is to transfer geometric correspondence while preserving the pretrained semantic alignment of the VLM.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations on image and video spatial reasoning, comparing against spatial QA fine-tuning, geometry-feature fusion, and direct feature distillation style baselines; exact model sizes, data scale, and numerical gains are not given.

recommendation.zh: 可略读方法图；关系蒸馏比特征蒸馏更稳这个点，对 VLM 预训练对齐有一点可迁移价值。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure; relational distillation being safer than feature matching is mildly useful for VLM alignment work.

paper.title: Geo-Spatial Concept Probing of Large Language Models: Abstraction, Compositionality, and Grounding
paper.abstract: Understanding concepts is fundamental to generalization. Despite their impressive performance on a wide range of tasks, Large Language Models (LLMs) still struggle with genuine concept understanding. Prior work has evaluated conceptual understanding in LLMs using natural-language benchmarks or narrowly scoped synthetic tasks, but these settings often conflate multiple skills or lack precise control over the underlying concepts and their properties. To support controlled probing of concepts in LL

summary.core_problem: 构造可控的地理空间概念 probing，评估 LLM 对 abstraction、compositionality 和 grounding 的掌握程度。
summary.importance: 这是概念理解评测贡献，不是预训练方法。它的价值在于把空间方向、距离、拓扑及其组合拆成较可控的 QA 测试，减少普通自然语言 benchmark 中多种能力混杂的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 设计 concept-centric benchmark，以 direction、distance、topology 等空间概念为核心，构造问答任务作为 probing 接口。论文比较不同 LLM 架构和训练 regime，分析 scale 与 design 对概念理解的影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要只说明覆盖多个 LLM 架构和训练设置，未给出具体模型清单、参数规模或提升幅度。主要结果是当前 LLM 在抽象、组合和 grounding 上仍有清晰限制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds controlled geo-spatial concept probes to evaluate abstraction, compositionality, and grounding in LLMs.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution rather than a pretraining method. Its value is in decomposing spatial concepts such as direction, distance, topology, and their compositions into controlled QA-style tests, reducing skill confounds found in natural-language benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors design a concept-centric benchmark around spatial relations and use question answering as the probing interface. They evaluate multiple LLM architectures and training regimes to study how scale and design choices affect conceptual understanding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions experiments across multiple LLM architectures and training setups but does not provide model names, parameter sizes, or numerical results. The main finding is that current LLMs show clear limitations in abstraction, compositionality, and grounding.

recommendation.zh: 作为 concept probing 备查即可；它测的是空间概念缺陷，离 pretrain recipe 还有一层，不必读实验细节。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a concept-probing reference; it measures spatial-concept failures, but the link to pretraining recipes is indirect.

paper.title: Trace, Verify, and Correct: A Training-Free Framework for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress, their spatial reasoning may still produce intermediate judgments inconsistent with the input image, allowing errors to propagate through the reasoning chain and affect the final answer. Existing methods mainly improve spatial reasoning through training or additional spatial information, without considering whether the reasoning process itself is faithful to the model input. Our study shows that unfaithful reasoning

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型的空间推理链常包含与输入图像不一致的中间判断，错误沿推理链传播导致最终答案失准，现有方法多通过训练或额外信息改进而未校验推理忠实度。
summary.importance: 首次从推理链忠实度角度切入 MLLM 空间推理，提出免训练的验证-修正框架，属于方法改进与忠实推理分析。
summary.technical_approach: 构建空间证据图 SEG，将 CoT 中抽取的原子空间证据与视觉实体、空间关系、来源步骤及视觉证据关联；设计空间证据可靠性评估 SERA，基于对象检测等评估证据可信度，再对不可靠步骤做模块化修正。
summary.experiments: 在多个 MLLM 空间推理基准上验证，忠实度提升显著带动最终答案准确率提升；对比训练式方法在零样本场景下保持竞争力。

summary_en.core_problem: Spatial reasoning chains in MLLMs often contain intermediate judgments inconsistent with the input image; errors propagate and degrade final accuracy, while existing methods mostly rely on training or extra spatial signals instead of verifying reasoning faithfulness.
summary_en.importance: First approach to MLLM spatial reasoning from the reasoning-faithfulness perspective; proposes a training-free verification-correction framework, contributing method improvement and faithful-reasoning analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a Spatial Evidence Graph (SEG) linking atomic spatial evidence extracted from CoT to visual entities, spatial relations, source steps and visual evidence; designs Spatial Evidence Reliability Assessment (SERA) to score evidence credibility via object detection, then applies modular correction to unreliable steps.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple MLLM spatial reasoning benchmarks; improved faithfulness consistently lifts final answer accuracy, and remains competitive against training-based methods under zero-shot settings.

recommendation.zh: 免训练后处理类工作，对预训练研究员仅作“空间推理失败模式”的参考素材，读实验失败案例即可。
recommendation.en: Training-free post-hoc correction work; useful to pretraining researchers only as a reference for spatial-reasoning failure modes, read failure-case analysis only.

paper.title: SpatialQuery: Benchmarking Geometry-Grounded Multi-Instance Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong semantic understanding but remain unreliable in metric spatial reasoning, particularly when queries require comparing multiple instances of the same object category. We study this problem through the Closest-Instance Distance Query (CIDQ), where a model must identify the nearest visible candidate to a unique reference object and estimate their gravity-aligned floor-plane distance. We introduce SPATIALQUERY, a training- free framework for CIDQ reasonin

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是评测单张 RGB 图像中的多实例度量空间推理：给定唯一参考物体和同类候选物体集合，模型需要找出最近候选实例，并估计其在重力对齐地面平面上的距离。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 LLM 基座预训练的直接相关性不强，更适合作为 VLM 几何能力评测资产来泛读。它的启发点在于把空间推理从“固定物体对距离估计”推进到“候选集合聚合、实例选择、度量距离估计”的组合问题。对于 native multimodal 预训练或视觉 tokenizer 研究，它提示了一个风险：语义识别能力强，并不代表模型形成了可用于物理世界推理的稳定几何表示。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是一个不训练模型的几何增强推理框架 SpatialQuery。流程先用目标 grounding、单目深度和相机几何估计恢复候选物体与参考物体的地面平面坐标；再通过 Scene Cubifying 把实例渲染成统一大小、类别编码的 BEV 方块，去掉外观、尺度和透视变化，只保留对 CIDQ 有用的相对几何；最后用 UA-CoT 把每个实例的几何不确定性写入多模态模型的推理提示，使模型在选择最近实例和给出距离时能感知重建可靠性。它没有改模型结构，也没有做任务微调，重点是把视觉输入转换成更适合 VLM 推理的中间表示。
summary.experiments: SpatialQuery-1M 包含来自 200 个室内场景的 100 万以上 RGB-only 问答样本。评测输入只有 RGB 图像和自然语言问题，3D 标注与相机参数只用于离线构造答案。任务包括最近实例距离估计和 proximity decision。严格 zero-shot 设置下，SpatialQuery 搭配 Qwen3-VL-8B 达到 Floor-MAE 0.259 m、Unc-Acc@0.3 m 90.5%、proximity-decision accuracy 84.18%。消融显示，稳健几何 refinement、规范化 BEV 表示和 uncertainty-aware prompting 各自提供互补收益。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 Task Definition 中 CIDQ 的形式化定义，确认它和常见 pairwise spatial QA 的区别；再看 Scene Cubifying 和 UA-CoT 的设计，理解为什么 BEV 抽象比直接把原图交给 VLM 更适合多实例比较。实验部分重点看不确定性分层分析和消融表，这些结果能帮助判断错误来自单目几何、实例漏检，还是语言模型的比较推理。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates multi-instance metric spatial reasoning from a single RGB image: given a unique reference object and multiple visible candidates from the same category, the model must select the nearest instance and estimate the gravity-aligned floor-plane distance.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to LLM pretraining is limited, but it is useful as a VLM geometry evaluation asset. The main signal is that spatial reasoning should not be reduced to fixed object-pair distance estimation. A model must aggregate a candidate set, avoid duplicate or missing instances, compare metric locations, and output a calibrated distance. For native multimodal pretraining and visual tokenizer work, it highlights a gap between semantic visual understanding and physically meaningful geometric representation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpatialQuery is a training-free geometry-assisted reasoning pipeline. It grounds reference and candidate objects, estimates monocular depth and camera geometry, and recovers floor-plane coordinates. Scene Cubifying then renders detected instances as uniformly sized, category-coded blocks on a canonical bird’s-eye-view canvas. This removes appearance, perspective, and object-scale distractions while preserving the geometry needed for the query. UA-CoT injects per-instance geometry uncertainty into the prompt, so the VLM can condition its answer on reconstruction reliability. The method changes the input representation and prompting protocol rather than the model architecture.
summary_en.experiments: SpatialQuery-1M contains over one million RGB-only question-answer pairs from 200 indoor scenes. Ground-truth 3D annotations and camera parameters are used only for offline benchmark construction; evaluated models receive only an RGB image and a natural-language query. The benchmark covers closest-instance distance estimation and proximity decision. Under a strict zero-shot protocol, SpatialQuery with Qwen3-VL-8B reports 0.259 m Floor-MAE, 90.5% Unc-Acc@0.3 m, and 84.18% proximity-decision accuracy. Ablations indicate that geometric refinement, canonical BEV rendering, and uncertainty-aware prompting contribute complementary gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Focus on the CIDQ task definition to see how the benchmark differs from pairwise spatial QA. Then read the Scene Cubifying and UA-CoT parts to understand why a BEV abstraction is easier for VLMs than raw perspective images. In the experiments, the most informative parts are the ablations and uncertainty-stratified analysis, because they separate failures due to monocular geometry, object grounding, and language-side comparison.

recommendation.zh: 读数据构造和失败案例即可；它检验 VLM 是否真有度量空间感，但不改预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and failure cases; it tests metric spatial grounding in VLMs, but does not change the pretraining recipe.

paper.title: SpatioLM: Towards General Physical Spatial Intelligence in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on commonsense reasoning tasks but struggle with visual spatial reasoning. Most existing solutions introduce extra 3D prior inputs or external spatial encoders, which increase complexity and degrade the underlying VLMs' general-purpose capabilities after spatial fine-tuning. To this end, we propose a parameter-efficient \textit{\textbf{Spatio}-vision \textbf{L}anguage \textbf{M}odels (SpatioLM)}, that enhances spatial intelligence without extra 3D prior

summary.core_problem: 提升 VLM 的物理空间理解能力，同时避免引入额外 3D 输入、外部空间编码器，或破坏原模型的通用能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态模型适配方法。它关注 VLM 预训练模型中潜在空间知识能否被轻量模块激发，对 native multimodal pretraining 的空间表征缺口有参考意义，但不是基座预训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SpatioLM：一个 plug-and-play、non-invasive 的 spatio-vision module，用于从已有 VLM 中 elicitation 空间知识。训练信号使用 pseudo depth 和 camera information 作为监督，引导模型学习更符合物理约束的空间表征，而不是直接接入第三方 3D encoder。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多类 spatial perception 和 spatial understanding 任务上有明显提升，并且限制了对原有通用 VLM 能力的退化。未给出模型参数、训练数据、baseline 名称或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve physical spatial reasoning in VLMs without adding explicit 3D inputs, external spatial encoders, or degrading the base model’s general capabilities.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal adaptation method. It is relevant because it probes whether spatial knowledge already exists in VLMs and can be elicited with light supervision, but it is not a foundation pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpatioLM adds a plug-and-play, non-invasive spatio-vision module to an existing VLM. It uses pseudo depth and camera information as supervision to encourage physically coherent spatial representations, avoiding a separate 3D encoder.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports significant improvements across spatial perception and understanding tasks while limiting degradation of general-purpose VLM abilities. It does not provide model size, data scale, baseline names, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看伪深度/相机监督怎么不伤通用能力；这是 VLM 空间微调经验，不是预训练新信号。
recommendation.en: Read only how pseudo-depth and camera supervision avoid hurting general ability; this is VLM spatial tuning evidence, not a new pretraining signal.

paper.title: SG-Layout: Structured Scene Graph-Guided Layout Generation with LLMs
paper.abstract: Understanding and generating spatially coherent layouts from natural language remains a fundamental yet challenging task for large language models (LLMs). Existing LLMs often struggle to capture explicit geometric relationships and structural dependencies between objects. To address this issue, we propose SG-Layout, a graph-guided layout generation framework that explicitly incorporates structured spatial knowledge into LLMs. SG-Layout follows a two-stage training paradigm: (1) a graph-language

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 从自然语言生成空间布局时难以显式建模几何关系和物体结构依赖的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是结构化条件注入和指令微调方法，用 scene graph 改善布局生成、室内场景合成和机器人重排；对 LLM 空间表示有参考意义，但不是基座预训练范式或训练目标创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SG-Layout，两阶段训练：第一阶段训练 relational graph encoder 和 projector，把 scene-graph embedding 对齐到 LLM 的语言表示空间；第二阶段用 LoRA adapter 做 instruction tuning，冻结 LLM backbone，让模型按指令生成结构更一致的布局。
summary.experiments: 在 image layout generation、indoor scene synthesis 和 robotic object rearrangement 上评估；摘要称 SG-Layout 提升空间推理能力，但未给出参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 列表或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 元数据标注机构为 Cohere；工作重点是把结构化 scene graph 对齐到 LLM 表示空间，用于空间布局生成。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the weakness of LLMs in generating spatially coherent layouts from natural language, especially explicit geometric relations and object dependencies.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a structured-conditioning and instruction-tuning method for layout generation, indoor scene synthesis, and robotic rearrangement. It is relevant to LLM spatial representation, but not a new foundation pretraining objective or modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: SG-Layout uses a two-stage pipeline. First, a relational graph encoder and projector are trained to align scene-graph embeddings with the LLM linguistic space. Second, LoRA adapters instruction-tune the frozen LLM backbone for layout generation under structured graph guidance.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on image layout generation, indoor scene synthesis, and robotic object rearrangement. The abstract claims improved spatial reasoning but does not provide model scale, training data size, baselines, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The metadata marks Cohere as the institution. The work focuses on aligning structured scene graphs with LLM representations for spatial layout generation.

recommendation.zh: 读方法图和两阶段训练即可；把 scene graph 接进 LLM 是清晰工程线索，但不是基座训练新范式。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and two-stage training; scene-graph injection is a clean engineering idea, not a new base-model training paradigm.

paper.title: SpatialCLI: Learning to Reason With Spatial Tools, Then Without Them
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in embodied agents to interpret visual inputs, reason about spatial relationships, and make task-level decisions based on that reasoning. However, a fundamental capability mismatch remains: general VLMs can reason about the overall task but often miss the visual details that determine success, while specialist vision models can capture those details but cannot translate them into task-level decisions. In this work, we propose SpatialCLI, a fram

summary.core_problem: 让 VLM 先通过调用专用空间视觉工具学会空间推理，再通过轨迹内化逐步摆脱工具依赖。
summary.importance: 提出“先用工具、再内化”的多阶段训练框架，并配套一个空间推理 benchmark，对具身 VLM 的工具使用到能力内化路径有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 三阶段流程：Call 将专用视觉模型封装为空间工具；Learn 用冷启动 SFT + agentic RL 学工具使用；Internalize 将成功工具轨迹语言化/轨迹化，监督模型内化感知能力。
summary.experiments: 构建 516 例 SpatialCLI-Bench；摘要未给出具体模型参数量、对照模型和详细指标。

summary_en.core_problem: SpatialCLI trains VLMs to reason with specialist spatial tools first, then internalizes those perceptual capabilities so they can reason without tools.
summary_en.importance: It explores a tool-use-to-internalization training pipeline for embodied spatial reasoning and contributes a companion benchmark, relevant to multimodal agent training but not to core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: A three-stage framework: Call exposes specialist vision models as spatial tools; Learn uses cold-start SFT and agentic RL to improve tool use; Internalize verbalizes successful tool-use trajectories to distill specialist perception into the VLM.
summary_en.experiments: Introduces SpatialCLI-Bench with 516 examples; model sizes, baselines, and quantitative gains are not detailed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 思路和视觉工具内化训练流程可作为多模态post-train参考，但不是pretrain工作，扫一眼三阶段设计即可。
recommendation.en: The tool-use-then-internalize recipe is relevant to multimodal post-training, but this is not a pretraining paper; skim the three-stage pipeline and skip implementation details.

paper.title: Visual Credit Audit for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Closed yes/no spatial benchmarks can reward a correct answer even when the image adds little support beyond no-image contexts. Under a fixed forced-choice interface, Visual Credit Audit (VCA) separates two estimands: whether the benchmark image gives the model's declared decision more support than text-only and blank controls, and whether the model responds to relation-specific visual evidence. summary.core_problem: 判断多模态空间推理 benchmark 中，模型答对 yes/no 题时是否真的使用了图像证据，而不是靠文本先验或选项偏置答对。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个视觉证据归因评测协议 Visual Credit Audit，用来拆分“答案正确”和“图像确实提供了决策支持”这两个量；这对 VLM 评测、视觉依赖性测量和多模态训练信号质量都有直接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 在固定 forced-choice 接口下，VCA 使用 text-only 和 blank controls，估计图像是否比无图条件更支持模型声明的决策；引入 dependence-credited correctness（D-CC）衡量带视觉依赖的正确性。论文还使用同 split 图像置换、固定像素关系对比和 3x3 evidence-source factorial，进一步区分是否响应关系特定的视觉证据。
summary.experiments: 在四个开源 MLLM 和两个空间推理 benchmark 上评测，发现 12.73%-26.25% 的决策虽然答案正确但没有获得视觉证据 credit；同 split 图像置换使 D-CC 下降 21.25-47.80 个点，且配对 95% 区间均大于零。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether correct yes/no answers on multimodal spatial reasoning benchmarks are actually supported by the image rather than by text-only priors or interface bias.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is Visual Credit Audit, an evaluation protocol that separates answer correctness from image-supported decision making. This matters for VLM evaluation, visual-dependence measurement, and the quality of multimodal training and reward signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under a fixed forced-choice interface, VCA compares the model's declared decision against text-only and blank controls to estimate whether the image adds decision support. It defines dependence-credited correctness, then uses matched same-split image permutation, fixed-pixel relation contrasts, and a 3x3 evidence-source factorial to test relation-specific visual grounding.
summary_en.experiments: Across four open MLLMs and two spatial benchmarks, 12.73%-26.25% of decisions are correct but uncredited. Matched same-split image permutation reduces D-CC by 21.25-47.80 points, with every paired 95% interval above zero.

recommendation.zh: 读 metric 定义和 permutation 实验即可；它会提醒你别把 VLM 正确率当成视觉 grounding 信号。
recommendation.en: Read the metric definition and permutation experiment; it is a useful warning against treating VLM accuracy as visual grounding.

paper.title: Spatial-IQ: Deconstructing Spatial Intelligence via Hierarchical Capability Tests
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at visual interpretation but fail on spatial reasoning tasks that humans solve reliably. Existing benchmarks evaluate these models as black boxes, limiting their ability to identify the underlying causes of lower performance: when a model fails a spatial reasoning task, it remains difficult to ascertain whether the hurdle is perceptual, such as recognizing object boundaries, or cognitive, such as reasoning about occlusion to infer hidden geometry. W

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型的空间推理评测仅返回最终任务的二元正确率，无法定位失败根因——无法区分错误来自低层次感知环节（如物体边界识别）还是高层次认知环节（如遮挡推断、支撑关系推理），也无法验证模型是否习得了与人类一致的层级化空间推理结构，而非依赖统计相关性猜测答案。
summary.importance: 为视觉语言模型的空间/物理常识能力评测提供了可诊断的分层框架，能够精确定位模型在物理世界建模上的能力短板；提出的分层任务分解式训练思路，为多模态模型空间能力的对齐训练提供了可复用的范式参考。
summary.technical_approach: 参考皮亚杰人类发展心理学与儿童空间认知标准化测试（考夫曼儿童评估测验的积木计数子项），将3D堆叠物体计数这一核心空间任务拆解为9个具有依赖关系、从感知到认知递进的子任务，额外加入心理旋转作为能力探针；基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim生成带全层级标注的合成视觉数据集，覆盖每个子任务的中间真值；训练侧提出两阶段方案：首先依据子任务依赖关系设计显式链式思考格式做监督微调，随后采用可验证奖励的强化学习，同时为最终答案正确和每个子步骤正确发放奖励。
summary.experiments: 覆盖闭源MLLM、开源MLLM、图像生成编辑模型的评测，并设置人类受试者作为对照，结果显示现有性能靠前的MLLM常能猜对最终计数结果，但中间子任务的正确率远低于人类，不具备人类表现出的层级推理依赖结构；初步训练结果显示，分层SFT结合分步RL的方案相比直接端到端训练最终答案有显著性能提升，可让模型习得类似人类的层级分解推理策略。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言部分对现有空间推理评测缺陷的分析、层级化任务拆解的设计逻辑，以及两阶段训练范式的动机，数据集生成的具体实现细节可略过，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks for multimodal large language models only return binary correctness scores for end tasks, failing to localize root causes of failures: they cannot distinguish errors originating from low-level perception (e.g., object boundary detection) from those caused by high-level cognitive deficits (e.g., occlusion inference, support relation reasoning), nor can they verify whether models acquire hierarchical spatial reasoning structures consistent with humans, rather than guessing answers via statistical correlations.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a diagnostic hierarchical evaluation framework for spatial and physical commonsense capabilities of vision-language models, enabling precise localization of weaknesses in physical world modeling. The proposed hierarchical task decomposition training approach offers a reusable paradigm reference for aligning spatial capabilities in multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by Piaget's developmental psychology and standardized children's spatial cognition tests (the Block Counting subtest of the Kaufman Assessment Battery for Children), the framework decomposes the core task of counting stacked 3D objects into 9 dependent subtasks progressing from perceptual to cognitive levels, with mental rotation added as an additional capability probe. Fully annotated synthetic visual stimuli are generated via NVIDIA Isaac Sim, with ground truth for all intermediate subtasks. For training, a two-stage pipeline is introduced: first supervised fine-tuning on an explicit chain-of-thought format derived from subtask dependencies, then reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, which grants rewards for both correct final answers and correct execution of each intermediate step.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover closed-source MLLMs, open-weight MLLMs, and image editing models, with human participants as a control group. Results show that top-performing MLLMs often guess the correct final count but perform far worse than humans on intermediate subtasks, lacking the hierarchical reasoning dependency structure observed in humans. Initial training results show that the combination of hierarchical SFT and stepwise RL delivers significant performance gains over end-to-end training on final answers alone, enabling models to learn human-like hierarchical decomposition strategies.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the introduction's analysis of limitations in existing spatial reasoning benchmarks, the design logic of hierarchical task decomposition, and the motivation for the two-stage training paradigm. Details of dataset generation can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做多模态预训练，读任务分解和误差归因设计就够了；它不改方法论，但能帮你把“空间推理差”拆成可训练的问题。
recommendation.en: If you work on multimodal pretraining, read the task decomposition and error attribution design; it won’t change your method, but it can turn “poor spatial reasoning” into trainable subproblems.

paper.title: Show, Don't Tell: Evaluating Spatial Cognition in Generative Pixels Rather Than LLM Text
paper.abstract: Spatial intelligence is essential for agents to move from static semantic understanding toward interacting with the physical world. Many spatial tasks are grounded in continuous visual scenes, where locations, regions, and paths are more naturally expressed by pointing, marking, or drawing than by reporting precise coordinates or discrete textual symbols. Yet existing spatial reasoning benchmarks usually require coordinates, options, or text, creating an answer-interface mismatch for image-gener

summary.core_problem: 现有空间推理评测几乎都假设模型用“文本/坐标/选项”作答，导致对图像生成模型（以像素为原生输出）的空间能力评测出现严重的 answer-interface mismatch：模型可能能“画出来/标出来”，但基准无法用原任务指标计分，也难以与文本输出 VLM 在同一语义任务下可控对比。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对“统一多模态生成范式（AR+diffusion/原生图像生成）如何被公平评测”有现实影响：如果评测接口不匹配，训练信号与模型选择会系统性偏向文本输出范式，间接影响多模态预训练路线的目标设计与数据构造。更具体的启发在于：把生成式模型的输出约束为可解析协议（protocolized output），用解析器回到结构化指标空间，能减少对 VLM-judge 的依赖与不确定性。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 ProVisE（Protocolized Visual Evaluation）框架：
1) 以“视觉协议”替代文本/坐标答案接口：要求图像生成模型在输出图像中以预定义格式表达答案（例如用特定颜色/形状标注区域、画路径、指向目标等），使输出天然落在像素空间但满足可解析约束。
2) 解析器把协议化图像输出转换为结构化预测（如 bbox/mask/路径点/方向标签等），从而复用原空间任务的标准指标，实现与文本输出 VLM 的 metric-compatible 对比。
3) 讨论手工为每个任务设计协议不可扩展，因此提供“Agentic construction path”：用代理式流程自动构造/选择协议与解析步骤（全文在引言处点到，细节需看方法章节）。
与常见替代方案的差异：
- 不走“VLM judge 读图给答案”的路线，避免把评测误差与 judge 能力耦合；
- 不把任务改写成文本多选/坐标回归，而是让生成模型用其擅长的像素表达，同时仍回到原任务指标。
summary.experiments:
给出的全文片段主要是问题定义与框架动机，尚未包含可复述的关键数字、模型清单、协议类型覆盖范围、解析鲁棒性统计、以及与 judge-based 评测的一致性/方差对比等结果细节。若论文后续章节提供：
- 不同协议在同一任务上的可解析率（parse success rate）与指标方差；
- 生成模型与文本 VLM 在同一任务语义下的可比性实验；
- 解析器误差对最终分数的敏感性分析；
这些会是判断其工程可落地性的关键证据。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 重点看 Figure 1（interface mismatch 的具体例子）以及方法章节对“协议约束 + 解析回结构化指标”的定义：协议如何设计、允许哪些自由度、如何防止模型钻协议空子。
- 优先找两类实验：①与 VLM-judge 方案的对照（相关性、方差、失败模式）；②跨任务/跨协议的可扩展性（是否每个任务都要重写大量规则）。
- 如果关心对预训练的启发，重点看作者是否讨论“把协议化输出作为训练目标/中间监督”的可能性，以及它与 unified multimodal generation（如 AR+diffusion）训练接口的关系。

summary_en.core_problem: Spatial reasoning benchmarks typically force answers into text, coordinates, or discrete options. This creates a severe answer-interface mismatch for image generation models whose native output is pixels: they may be able to externalize spatial judgments by drawing/marking, but the benchmark cannot score those outputs with the original task metrics, making controlled comparison with text-output VLMs unreliable.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on pretraining recipes, but it matters for how multimodal generative paradigms (native image generators, AR+diffusion unified models) are evaluated and therefore selected and optimized. The key idea—constraining generative outputs into a parseable protocol and mapping them back to structured predictions—reduces dependence on VLM-as-a-judge and can make evaluation signals less model-dependent and less noisy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ProVisE (Protocolized Visual Evaluation) proposes:
1) Protocol-constrained visual answers: the generator must express the answer in a predefined visual format (e.g., specific markers, highlights, trajectories) rather than text/coordinates.
2) A task-specific parser converts the generated image into structured outputs compatible with the benchmark’s original metrics (bbox/mask/path/labels), enabling metric-compatible evaluation.
3) Since hand-crafting protocols per task does not scale, an agentic construction pipeline is introduced to help build protocols/parsers (the provided excerpt signals this; details should be in the methods section).
Compared to common workarounds:
- It avoids judge-based scoring where a separate VLM interprets the generated image, which entangles evaluation with judge reliability.
- It avoids rewriting tasks into unnatural symbolic interfaces that disadvantage pixel-native models.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided full-text excerpt is largely motivation and framing; it does not include reproducible quantitative results (models, datasets, protocol coverage, parse success rates, robustness, or correlations vs judge-based evaluation). The most decision-critical evidence to look for in later sections is:
- Parse success rate and failure modes across protocols/tasks.
- Agreement/variance comparisons against VLM-judge baselines.
- Sensitivity of final scores to parser errors and protocol degrees of freedom.
- Cross-task scalability showing how much manual engineering is still required.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with Figure 1 to internalize the interface mismatch.
- Read the method section defining the protocol format and the parsing pipeline; check how they prevent loopholes and ensure unambiguous decoding.
- Jump to experiments that compare (a) protocol+parser scoring vs VLM-judge scoring, and (b) scalability across multiple spatial task types.
- If you care about pretraining implications, look for discussion on using protocolized visual outputs as training targets or intermediate supervision for unified multimodal generators.

recommendation.zh: 只看协议化像素答案解析；它可能影响统一生成模型的空间评测接口。
recommendation.en: Skim the protocol-constrained pixel parsing; it may matter for evaluating spatial reasoning in unified generative models.

paper.title: Geo3R: Mitigating Spatial Reasoning Hallucination in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Despite remarkable progress in visual understanding, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) remain prone to hallucinations when reasoning about spatial relationships, often producing judgments that contradict the true 3D structure of the scene. Though several existing works have proposed to mitigate hallucinations, our analysis indicates that they show limited effectiveness in spatial reasoning, as they fail to bridge the fundamental gap between 2D visual representations and 3D spatial reality

summary.core_problem: 研究 MLLM 在空间关系判断中产生与真实 3D 场景结构矛盾的幻觉，并尝试用几何证据降低这类错误。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态幻觉分析与训练无关的缓解方法。它把空间结构建模不足导致的错误单独定义为 spatial reasoning hallucination，并指出透视效应、物体朝向、视角变化是高发场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Geo3R，一个 training-free、plug-and-play 框架，将外部几何证据和结构信息接入 MLLM 推理过程。方法重点不是重新训练 VLM，而是在推理侧补充 3D 相关约束，弥补 2D 视觉表征到 3D 空间现实之间的缺口。
summary.experiments: 摘要称已有幻觉缓解方法在空间推理场景效果有限，并用 Geo3R 进行缓解；题面未给出具体模型规模、数据集、指标和提升幅度，实验可信度需要看正文中的场景构造和失败案例覆盖。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets spatial-reasoning hallucinations in MLLMs, where predicted relations contradict the underlying 3D scene structure.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly a multimodal hallucination analysis plus a training-free mitigation framework. It separates spatial reasoning hallucination from generic relation hallucination and highlights perspective effects, object orientation, and viewpoint changes as recurring failure modes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Geo3R is proposed as a plug-and-play inference-time framework that injects geometric evidence and structural cues into MLLM reasoning. The method does not retrain the VLM; it tries to compensate for the gap between 2D visual representations and 3D spatial reality.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that existing hallucination mitigation methods have limited effectiveness for spatial reasoning and that Geo3R improves this setting. The provided excerpt does not include model sizes, datasets, metrics, or effect sizes, so the experimental setup needs inspection in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看错误 taxonomy 和案例即可；方法偏推理侧补丁，对基座预训练的动作信号很弱。
recommendation.en: Read the failure taxonomy and examples only; the method is an inference-side patch with weak signal for base pretraining.

paper.title: OrientSAM: Mitigating Camera-Centric Shortcut in Multimodal Spatial Reasoning via Orientation-Aware Spatial Alignment
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still struggle with spatial reasoning that requires perspective transformation. In particular, they often rely on camera-centric cues rather than reasoning from the reference object's viewpoint, leading to systematic errors in non-camera reference settings. In this paper, we first analyze this failure mode and show that object orientation is a key factor underlying such camera-centric shortcut behavior. To address this issue, we propose OrientSAM, an orie

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型在空间推理任务中依赖相机视角的捷径线索，而非从参考物体视角进行推理，导致非相机参考设置下出现系统性错误。
summary.importance: 方法创新与数据贡献：首次系统分析相机中心捷径的失效模式，提出方向感知的空间对齐框架，并构建大规模方向感知空间监督数据生成管线。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OrientSAM，通过方向感知token与傅里叶角度编码将显式朝向信息注入多模态表示，同时采用课程学习逐步提升视角感知推理能力；配套空间数据构造管线从大规模图像生成方向感知监督。
summary.experiments: 在Spatial-MM、ViewSpatial、3DS等空间推理基准上验证方法有效性，对比基线模型在非相机参考视角任务上的错误率下降与推理准确率提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal LLMs rely on camera-centric shortcut cues during spatial reasoning instead of reasoning from the reference object's perspective, causing systematic failures under non-camera reference settings.
summary_en.importance: Methodological and data contribution: it first systematically analyzes the camera-centric shortcut failure mode, proposes an orientation-aware spatial alignment framework, and builds a pipeline to generate large-scale orientation-aware spatial supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: OrientSAM injects explicit orientation information into multimodal representations via orientation-aware tokens and Fourier-based angle encoding, adopts curriculum learning to progressively improve perspective-aware reasoning, and uses a spatial data pipeline to generate orientation supervision from large-scale images.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Spatial-MM, ViewSpatial and 3DS benchmarks, demonstrating reduced error rates and improved accuracy on non-camera perspective spatial reasoning tasks compared with baseline models (specific metrics not fully provided in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 属于VLM空间推理的细分改进，对预训练研究员仅作弱信号参考，关注其方向编码设计即可，无需深入正文。
recommendation.en: A niche improvement for VLM spatial reasoning; only the orientation encoding design is worth noting as a weak signal, no need to read the full paper.

paper.title: Towards Spatial Supersensing in the Wild
paper.abstract: Humans can efficiently parse continuous sensory streams, from hours to years, scaffolding an internal world model that grounds spatial reasoning and prediction. To mimic this capacity, spatial supersensing challenges multimodal models to move beyond linguistic understanding toward true world modeling. However, their benchmark relies on synthetic long videos, formed by concatenating random short clips, and is mostly limited to household scenes, leaving real-world continuity and diversity underexp

summary.core_problem: 现有空间超感知评测基准依赖拼接的合成短视频、局限于家庭场景，无法有效评估多模态模型在真实野外长时序下的world modeling能力。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，首次构建了真实野外场景的长时序空间超感知评测数据集，系统覆盖agent、物体、环境三元世界状态的探测。
summary.technical_approach: 参考人类认知中经验结构化的机制，设计针对世界状态三元组（观察者agent、场景物体、全局环境布局）的系统化探测问题，构建人工验证的QA对评测集。
summary.experiments: VSI-Super-Wild包含6980条人工验证的问答对，基于真实野外长时序多模态数据构建，覆盖多样场景与长时序空间推理任务。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing spatial supersensing benchmarks rely on concatenated synthetic short videos and are limited to household scenes, failing to validly evaluate multimodal models' world modeling capacity in real-world long-horizon in-the-wild settings.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: the first large-scale spatial supersensing evaluation dataset for real-world in-the-wild long-horizon scenarios, covering the full triad of world state (agent, object, environment).
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by cognitive studies on human experience structuring, the benchmark systematically designs probing questions targeting the world state triad (observer agent, scene objects, global environment layout) and constructs human-verified QA pairs.
summary_en.experiments: VSI-Super-Wild contains 6,980 human-verified QA pairs, built on real-world in-the-wild long-temporal multimodal data, covering diverse scenarios and long-horizon spatial reasoning tasks.

recommendation.zh: 多模态world modeling方向的细分评测基准，仅作为领域文献备查，无需阅读正文。
recommendation.en: A niche evaluation benchmark for multimodal world modeling, only for literature reference, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: When Depth Is Better Told Than Shown: Depth-Ordinal Prompting for Vision-Language Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are expected to reason about physical space -- which object is closer, what lies behind what, and how objects are arranged in 3D -- yet they still struggle with such spatial judgments. A natural remedy is to show the model a depth map, but we find that this can make performance worse. We show that depth is not absent: it reaches the language model, but becomes difficult to access for downstream reasoning, while rendered pseudo-depth maps act as noisy auxiliary image

summary.core_problem: VLM在3D空间关系推理（如物体远近、前后遮挡判断）上表现不佳，直接输入伪深度图作为辅助模态反而会进一步降低性能。
summary.importance: 首次明确发现深度信号的呈现形式（图像vs文本）对冻结VLM空间推理能力的反向影响，提出免训练、无标注的提示方法，属于方法创新+反常识发现。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Depth-Ordinal Prompting（DOP），先通过单目深度估计器得到深度信息，再针对查询问题中的目标对象，将深度关系转换为有序文本提示注入输入，无需训练模型、修改架构或注入视觉特征。
summary.experiments: 跨多个空间推理benchmark、不同VLM模型和不同深度估计器测试，DOP均能稳定提升空间推理准确率，且显著优于直接输入深度图的方案。

summary_en.core_problem: VLMs underperform on 3D spatial relation reasoning (e.g., object proximity, occlusion order judgment), and directly inputting pseudo-depth maps as auxiliary modality further degrades performance.
summary_en.importance: First explicitly identifies the reverse impact of depth signal presentation format (image vs text) on frozen VLMs' spatial reasoning, proposes a training-free, annotation-free prompting method, belonging to methodological innovation + counterintuitive finding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Depth-Ordinal Prompting (DOP), which first obtains depth information via monocular depth estimators, then converts depth relations into ordinal text prompts for query-targeted objects and injects them into the input, without model training, architecture modification or visual feature injection.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across multiple spatial reasoning benchmarks, various VLMs and different depth estimators; DOP consistently improves spatial reasoning accuracy and significantly outperforms the direct depth map input scheme.

recommendation.zh: 反常识发现值得参考，深度信号以文本而非图像形式注入冻结VLM更有效，仅看摘要和§3核心实验即可。
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive finding worth noting; injecting depth as text rather than image works better for frozen VLMs, read abstract and §3 core experiments only.

paper.title: MindEdit-Bench: Benchmarking Object-Level Counterfactual Spatial Reasoning in VLMs from In-the-Wild Photos
paper.abstract: Benchmarks for vision-language models (VLMs) mostly test observational spatial reasoning: models describe relations already visible in the input. Existing what-if tasks typically vary the observer while keeping the scene fixed. Can VLMs instead predict the consequences of hypothetically moving or rotating an object? We introduce MindEdit-Bench, a benchmark of six spatial reasoning tasks built from three-photo smartphone triplets of newly captured indoor scenes via an automatic in-the-wild 3D sce

summary.core_problem: 现有 VLM 基准主要测试观测性空间推理，缺乏对物体级反事实空间推理能力（预测物体移动/旋转后的结果，答案不在输入图像中）的系统评测。
summary.importance: Benchmark 贡献，首次构建基于真实野外室内场景的物体级反事实空间推理评测基准，包含 2 个全新的反事实推理任务。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MindEdit-Bench，通过自动的野外 3D 场景图提取管线，从新拍摄的室内场景三联智能手机照片中构建 6 个空间推理任务：4 个感知与视角变换任务，2 个新的反事实任务（空间编辑、跨视角可见性编辑），每个问题提供 8-24 个结构化选项，支持错误模式诊断。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 120 个私有室内场景，未使用公开数据集以减少数据泄露风险；在多个主流 VLM 上的评测显示，现有模型在反事实空间推理任务上表现显著差于观测性任务。
summary.authors_note: 浙江大学、同济大学、东京大学合作完成。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLM benchmarks mostly test observational spatial reasoning, lacking systematic evaluation of object-level counterfactual spatial reasoning (predicting consequences of moving/rotating objects, with correct answers absent from input images).
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: first object-level counterfactual spatial reasoning benchmark built on real-world in-the-wild indoor scenes, including 2 novel counterfactual reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes MindEdit-Bench, built via an automatic in-the-wild 3D scene-graph extraction pipeline from newly captured three-photo smartphone triplets of indoor scenes, with 6 spatial reasoning tasks: 4 on perception and perspective transformation, 2 novel counterfactual tasks (spatial editing, cross-view visibility editing); each question has 8-24 structured options for error diagnosis.
summary_en.experiments: Covers 120 private indoor scenes not drawn from public datasets to reduce data leakage risk; evaluation on multiple mainstream VLMs shows models perform significantly worse on counterfactual spatial reasoning than on observational tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration between Zhejiang University, Tongji University, and The University of Tokyo.

recommendation.zh: VLM反事实空间推理新基准，可用于多模态预训练的能力诊断，看任务定义部分即可
recommendation.en: A new benchmark for VLM counterfactual spatial reasoning, useful for multimodal pretraining capability diagnosis; read task definition only.

paper.title: Technical Report of RoboSpatial Challenge at CVPR 2026: Selective Reasoning Activation and Reference-Frame Disambiguation for Embodied Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models achieve strong general perception but often struggle with the spatial reasoning required for embodied tasks. We present RoboSpatialBrain, our submission to the RoboSpatial Challenge at the Embodied Reasoning in Action Workshop, CVPR 2026, built on RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV. RoboSpatialBrain combines two training-free, inference-time mechanisms: a forced <think> prefix activation strategy paired with a task-specific post-prompt that elicits deliberate reasoning on context and comp

summary.core_problem: 解决VLM在具身空间推理中对参考系歧义和是否触发显式推理链把握不稳的问题。
summary.importance: 这是挑战赛技术报告，不是新的预训练方法。价值主要在于两个推理时技巧：选择性激活思维链，以及显式参考系重定向。对做多模态推理和具身VLM的人有一点实操参考，但对基座预训练启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV，提出两项 training-free 推理机制：一是强制加入 <think> 前缀并配合任务特定后提示，促使模型在上下文与兼容性任务上进行显式推理；二是参考系重定向流水线，把相机中心和物体中心坐标系歧义显式消解。作者还探索了在兼容性数据上的微调及其与提示策略的相互作用。
summary.experiments: 在 RoboSpatial Challenge / RoboSpatial-Home 上评估，报告总体成功率 80.9%，获得挑战赛第一。摘要未给出更多基线细节、数据规模或统计显著性，因此更像经验性系统组合而非干净方法学结论。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets embodied spatial reasoning failures in VLMs, especially reference-frame ambiguity and when to trigger explicit reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a challenge technical report rather than a new pretraining method. Its value lies in two practical inference-time tricks: selective reasoning activation and explicit reference-frame redirection. Useful as a systems note for multimodal reasoning, but only loosely relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV, the system adds two training-free inference mechanisms: a forced <think> prefix plus task-specific post-prompt to elicit deliberate reasoning, and a reference-frame redirection pipeline to resolve camera-centric versus object-centric ambiguity. The authors also explore fine-tuning on compatibility data and its interaction with prompting.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on RoboSpatial Challenge / RoboSpatial-Home, it reports 80.9% overall success and first place in the challenge. The abstract does not provide much detail on baselines, data scale, or statistical rigor, so this reads more like a strong system recipe than a clean methodological result.

recommendation.zh: 比赛解法，方法新意一般；只看参考系消歧和 <think> 触发是否真带来稳定增益，别把榜单名次当成可迁移结论。
recommendation.en: A challenge solution with modest novelty; only inspect whether reference-frame disambiguation and forced <think> actually yield stable gains, and do not overread the leaderboard result.

paper.title: Decodable Is Not Grounded: A Vision-Ablation Arbiter for VLM Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: The standard way to read latent knowledge out of a model, a linear probe confirmed by a steering recovery, can systematically overstate what a vision-language model (VLM) actually grounds in the image. We show this on spatial reasoning, where the error is invisible to both probing and steering yet exposed by a one-line causal control: replacing the image with a gray blank. Probes decode the within-axis answer at 73--97% across axes, and a training-free projection lifts a near-chance axis from 59

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要纠正一个在 VLM 机制分析里很常见、但容易误判的推断链条：如果某个属性能被线性 probe 从中间表征里高精度解码出来，而且沿着该方向做无训练 steering/projection 还能把行为拉好，是否就能说明模型“已经具备这项视觉知识，只是没有正确调用”。作者用空间推理里的相机相对方向判断做了一个很干净的反例。结论是：不能。因为 probe 解到的可能只是语言先验，steering 拉起来的也可能只是把先验放大，而不是把视觉 grounding 重新接通。更进一步，模型还可能处在一种更隐蔽的状态：它确实在看图，但把视觉信号用反了，导致真实图像下反而低于随机猜测。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义不在于空间推理这个任务本身，而在于它给出了一个很低成本、但判别力很强的因果控制：把图像替换成同尺寸灰图，再看准确率和 steering 增益如何变化。这个控制把原本会被 probe-and-steer 统一解释成“latent knowledge not deployed”的现象，拆成三类机制：真实 grounded 且方向正确、真实 grounded 但符号反了、以及完全由 prior 驱动。对做 VLM 预训练、表征分析、representation engineering、latent capability recovery 的人，这个结论很直接：只看可解码性和可操控性不够，必须显式检查信息是否依赖视觉输入。否则很容易把“可读出”误当成“已 grounding”，把“可恢复”误当成“视觉能力被释放”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有三层。第一层是任务分解。作者选用 ViewSpatial-Bench 里的 camera-relative direction 子集，把问题拆成 horizontal、vertical、depth 三个纯轴向子任务，并区分 18 类原始准确率和 axis 内二分类准确率。这个设计很关键，因为它让“哪一维出了问题”可以被单独定位，而不是被混合空间关系掩盖。第二层是标准的 probe + steering 管线。作者在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 的 decision token residual stream 上做五折交叉验证 logistic probe，先 PCA 到 50 维，再逐层读出每个轴的方向；随后用 diff-of-means 或 probe weight 回投得到方向，在 L20-L24 这一带做无训练 projection/activation edit，用单一全局系数 gamma 放大 top-k 神经元上的局部方向。按传统解释，这一步如果能显著提升行为，就会被视为“模型内部已有该知识，只是没部署出来”。第三层才是论文真正的核心：vision-ablation arbiter。它不改 prompt、不改选项、不改解码，只把图像换成同尺寸灰图，再比较真实图像与灰图条件下的基线准确率和 steering 后增益。作者据此定义三种 grounding regime：如果真实图像显著优于灰图，且灰图退到机会水平，说明该轴是 grounded-correct；如果真实图像低于机会水平，而灰图回到机会附近，说明模型在看图，但把视觉 cue 的符号用反了，即 grounded-inverted；如果真实图像和灰图几乎一致，且 steering 增益在两种条件下也一致，则说明 probe/steering 读到并放大的只是 prior，而非视觉信息。作者还做了多种稳健性检查，避免“灰图本身是异常输入”这个反驳，包括其他形式的视觉消融和 in-distribution 但语义不匹配的真实图像替换。全文后半部分进一步分析 depth inversion 的几何来源，并尝试最小编辑修正：在表征最集中的模型上，训练自由的 rotation 就能纠正；在表征更分散的模型上，需要训练式低秩编辑。这一点把“错误是局部几何错位还是分布式表征问题”也区分开了。
summary.experiments: 最关键的结果集中在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的三轴对比。基线行为上，horizontal 表现较强，vertical 接近随机，depth 低于随机。probe 却给出相反印象：三个轴都能从 residual stream 解出来，vertical 甚至最好，文中给出的 within-axis probe 准确率大致是 vertical 94%、horizontal 85%，整体范围在 73% 到 97% 之间。更诱人的是无训练 projection：vertical 轴的行为准确率能从 59% 提到 79%，而 horizontal 基本不受影响，这正是“latent knowledge 被解锁”的典型信号。但灰图仲裁一做，解释完全变了。horizontal 在真实图像下约 82%，灰图掉到 49%，说明它确实依赖视觉；depth 在真实图像下只有 31%，灰图回到 45%，说明错误恰恰来自看图；vertical 则在真实图像和灰图下几乎一样，59% 对 60%，而 projection 增益也几乎一样，盲图 +19、真实图 +21，说明被放大的不是视觉表征，而是一个“默认 above”的语言先验。泛化实验覆盖 14 个 VLM、6 个 LM family、2B 到 27B 参数。作者报告的总体模式是：能力较强的模型里，horizontal 往往 grounded-correct，vertical 多数 prior-driven，depth inversion 会随规模在家族内部出现。另一个重要结果是任务边界：同一批模型在 camera-egocentric depth 上会 inverted，但在 near-field depth 和 metric depth 上又能 grounded-correct，说明问题不是“模型完全不懂深度”，而是某一类相机坐标语义映射出了系统性符号错误。修正实验里，7/8 个模型、5 个 family 复现了 depth inversion；最干净的模型可用训练自由 rotation 修正，效果接近训练式编辑，而更分布式的模型则需要低秩训练编辑，形成一个按 correction complexity 排列的谱系。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但建议把引言、4 节、5 节、6 节连着看。引言已经把最重要的反常现象和三类 regime 讲清楚。4 节要重点看三轴在 probe、基线行为、灰图控制、projection 增益上的并列表格或图，那里能直接看到“最可解码的轴反而最不 grounded”。如果只看一张图，优先看真实图像与灰图条件并排的结果图。5 节值得快速扫一遍，因为它回答了两个常见质疑：这是不是 Qwen 单模型偶然现象，以及灰图是不是 out-of-distribution artifact。6 节如果关心表征编辑和机制解释，可以细看。那里讨论了 depth inversion 是不是一个可由简单几何旋转修正的局部错位，以及为什么有些模型需要训练式低秩编辑。阅读时要抓住一个主线：作者不是在否定 probe 或 steering，而是在给它们加一个必要的因果判别步骤。预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主要结论；如果要复现实验，优先关注 setup、arbiter 定义、以及附录里的消融细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper challenges a common inference in VLM interpretability: if a target attribute is linearly decodable from hidden states, and a training-free steering/projection along that direction improves behavior, does that mean the model already has the visual knowledge but fails to deploy it? The answer here is no. Using camera-relative spatial reasoning as a controlled case, the authors show that decodability and steerability can both be high even when the behavior is not grounded in the image at all. They also uncover a second failure mode that is easy to miss: the model may genuinely use visual evidence, but with the wrong sign, so looking at the image makes it worse than chance.
summary_en.importance: The main value is methodological. The paper introduces a very cheap causal control—replace the image with a same-size gray blank and rerun the exact same prompt and decoding—that separates three mechanisms that probing and steering otherwise collapse into one story. For pretraining and representation-analysis work on VLMs, this matters because many claims about latent capability recovery rely on the chain “decodable therefore represented, steerable therefore recoverable.” This study shows that such claims are incomplete unless they test whether the recovered behavior actually depends on vision. In practice, the proposed arbiter is simple enough to become a default control for probe-based and representation-engineering results in multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup is deliberately narrow and controlled. The authors use the camera-relative direction subset of ViewSpatial-Bench and decompose items into pure horizontal, vertical, and depth axes, which avoids mixing different spatial factors. They evaluate both the native 18-way task accuracy and a within-axis binary accuracy. On top of this task decomposition, they run a standard probe-and-steer pipeline on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. A five-fold cross-validated logistic probe is trained on PCA-50 residual-stream features at the decision token, layer by layer, to decode each axis. Steering directions are then extracted either from class mean differences or from back-projected probe weights, and injected as a training-free activation edit in the L20-L24 band, scaled by residual-stream standard deviations and concentrated on top-k neurons with a single global coefficient. Up to this point, the setup mirrors the usual latent-knowledge recovery recipe. The key addition is the vision-ablation arbiter. The image is replaced by a gray blank while keeping the prompt, answer options, and decoding unchanged. The signed gap between real-image and blank-image performance is then used to classify each axis into one of three regimes: grounded-correct if real-image performance is higher and blank performance collapses toward chance; grounded-inverted if real-image performance is below chance but blank performance returns toward chance; prior-driven if real and blank conditions are statistically indistinguishable, including under steering. The paper also includes robustness checks against the objection that a gray blank is an unnatural input, using multiple ablations and mismatched but in-distribution real images. In later sections, the authors analyze the geometry of depth inversion and test minimal corrective edits. Some models can be fixed by a training-free rotation in representation space, while others require a trained low-rank edit, suggesting a spectrum from localized geometric misalignment to more distributed errors.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result comes from the three-axis analysis on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Behaviorally, horizontal is strong, vertical is near chance, and depth is below chance. Probing tells a very different story: all three axes are decodable from the residual stream, with vertical being the most decodable. The reported within-axis probe accuracies span roughly 73% to 97%, with vertical around 94% and horizontal around 85%. The training-free projection result looks even more convincing under the standard interpretation: vertical task accuracy rises from about 59% to 79%, while horizontal remains largely unchanged, exactly the pattern one would describe as unlocking latent knowledge. The gray-image arbiter overturns that interpretation. Horizontal drops from about 82% with the real image to 49% with the blank, so it is genuinely vision-grounded. Depth rises from 31% with the real image to 45% with the blank, showing that the error requires looking at the image and is therefore grounded but inverted. Vertical stays essentially unchanged, about 59% versus 60%, and the projection gain is almost identical with and without vision, roughly +21 versus +19, indicating that the decoded and amplified signal is a prior rather than visual grounding. The broader sweep covers 14 VLMs from 6 LM families, ranging from 2B to 27B parameters. The recurring pattern is that horizontal tends to be grounded-correct in capable models, vertical is often prior-driven, and depth inversion emerges with scale within families. Another important result is the task boundary: the same models that invert camera-egocentric depth can still be grounded-correct on near-field and metric depth, which argues against a generic lack of depth understanding and points instead to a specific coordinate-mapping failure. In the correction study, depth inversion replicates in 7 of 8 tested models across 5 families. The cleanest model can be corrected by a training-free rotation with performance close to a trained edit, whereas more distributed models need a low-rank trained intervention.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim-level read, focus on the introduction and the sections that compare probe accuracy, baseline behavior, and gray-image controls side by side. Those pages contain the central lesson: the most decodable axis can be the least grounded. The cross-model section is worth a quick pass because it answers two obvious questions—whether the phenomenon is specific to one model, and whether the blank-image control is just an out-of-distribution artifact. If you care about mechanistic editing, spend extra time on the correction section, where the paper distinguishes simple geometric misalignment from more distributed representational errors. A practical reading strategy is to track one question throughout: when behavior improves after steering, is the model using more vision, or just using its prior more strongly? Around 25–35 minutes should be enough to extract the main claims and the experimental logic.

recommendation.zh: 只看 blank-image arbiter 和三类 grounding taxonomy；它会降低你对 VLM probe/steering 结果的信任。
recommendation.en: Read the blank-image arbiter and the three-regime taxonomy; it should make you less trusting of VLM probe-and-steer claims.

paper.title: AirGroundBench: Probing Spatial Intelligence in Multimodal Large Models under Heterogeneous Multi-View Embodied Collaboration
paper.abstract: In recent years, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for embodied intelligence, yet their ability to maintain geometrically consistent spatial understanding across heterogeneous views remains under-evaluated. Existing benchmarks largely focus on single-agent, single-view perception, leaving a gap in the systematic assessment of collaborative air-ground settings, where multi-scale observations are complementary but introduce scale mismatch, asymmetric occlusion, a

summary.core_problem: 提出一个评测多模态大模型在空地异构多视角协作中空间理解能力的 benchmark，重点考察跨视角几何一致性、尺度差异、遮挡和参考系转换。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测资产。它把 MLLM 空间智能评测从单智能体、单视角扩展到 UAV-UGV 协作场景，对 VLM/embodied eval 有一定参考价值，但场景较窄，离预训练方法本身较远。
summary.technical_approach: AirGroundBench 基于 11 个高保真模拟环境构建，包含同步的空中与地面观察对。任务设计覆盖双视角视觉问答和闭环视觉语言导航，用异构视角制造尺度不匹配、非对称遮挡和参考系不一致等诊断条件。
summary.experiments: 数据规模包括 1,021 组同步空地观察对、约 62,000 个双视角四选一 VQA 样本，以及 115 个闭环视觉语言导航 episode。摘要未给出被测模型列表、分数区间或模型间差距。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating spatial intelligence in multimodal large models under heterogeneous UAV-UGV multi-view collaboration.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset. It extends MLLM spatial evaluation beyond single-agent and single-view settings, but the domain is still specialized and only indirectly relevant to pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: AirGroundBench is built from 11 high-fidelity simulated environments with synchronized aerial and ground observations. It creates diagnostic conditions such as scale mismatch, asymmetric occlusion, and reference-frame inconsistency through dual-view VQA and closed-loop vision-language navigation tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 1,021 synchronized air-ground observation pairs, roughly 62,000 dual-view four-choice VQA instances, and 115 closed-loop vision-language navigation episodes. The abstract does not report the evaluated model set or exact scores.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务定义和数据构成即可；它能提醒 VLM 预训练别只盯单视角，但不是会改训练 recipe 的证据。
recommendation.en: Read only the task design and dataset composition; it flags a VLM evaluation blind spot, but it is not evidence for changing a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: From Hallucination to Grounding: Diagnosing Visual Spatial Intelligence via CRISP
paper.abstract: Current VLM evaluations often conflate language priors with genuine spatial reasoning. To address this, we introduce CRISP, a novel structural-diagnostic evaluation paradigm that assesses visual spatial intelligence through consistency, the alignment between implicit perception and explicit reasoning. Unlike traditional black-box QA, CRISP utilizes metric 3D Scene Graphs and an oracle intervention protocol to decouple latent reasoning capabilities from perceptual bottlenecks. This granular diagn

summary.core_problem: 如何评测 VLM 的“真实空间推理/几何理解”，并把语言先验带来的答对与真正基于视觉结构的推理区分开；同时诊断失败到底来自感知（几何估计不准）还是来自推理（逻辑能力不足）。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的关联主要在评测与诊断：它提供一种把“结构化中间表示”作为信息瓶颈的评测范式（QA + 3D Scene Graph Construction），并用干预实验把感知瓶颈与推理瓶颈拆开。这类诊断对多模态预训练的 loss 设计（是否需要显式结构监督/对齐）、tokenization/表示（是否需要更可控的几何表征）有启发，但它不是预训练方法论文，更多是评测资产与分析框架。
summary.technical_approach:
CRISP 是一个结构诊断式评测范式：
- 双任务耦合：同一场景同时做空间 QA（判别式问答）与 3D Scene Graph Construction（生成式构图）。3D 场景图包含对象与其 3D metric 关系/拓扑，作为“强约束的信息瓶颈”，迫使模型外化其隐式空间表征。

- 干预诊断：用 ground-truth 结构图替换模型自预测结构图，比较两种条件下的 QA/推理表现，以定位是感知端（结构估计）还是推理端（使用结构进行推理）的问题。
- 数据构建：从 nuScenes 与 ScanNet++ 选取 1,162 个静态单视角场景，严格可见性过滤（遮挡、截断、像素尺寸阈值）、多样性过滤（去语义冗余、按复杂度平衡），并用数值 ID 构建 Master 3D 场景图以减少文本泄漏。

泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction：它把问题界定为“结构化空间感知 vs 语义识别”，并解释为什么传统 VQA 容易被语言先验污染。
- 重点看 CRISP 的评测协议：双任务设计、跨任务一致性度量、以及 ground-truth graph / self-predicted graph 的干预对照，这是方法论贡献。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate whether VLMs truly understand 3D spatial structure (metric relations, topology) rather than exploiting language priors, and how to disentangle perception failures (bad geometry estimation) from reasoning failures (inability to reason over structure).
summary_en.importance: Primarily an evaluation/diagnostic contribution. It proposes using a structured intermediate representation (metric 3D scene graphs) as an information bottleneck and introduces an intervention protocol to separate perception bottlenecks from reasoning bottlenecks. For multimodal pretraining, the value is indirect: it suggests what kinds of supervision/alignment signals might be missing (explicit structural grounding, controllable geometric representations), but it is not a new pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CRISP is a structural diagnostic paradigm:
- Dual-task coupling: spatial QA plus generative 3D Scene Graph Construction (SGC) on the same scene. The 3D scene graph encodes objects and metric 3D relations/topology, forcing the model to externalize its implicit spatial model.
- Cross-task consistency: evaluate whether the QA answer/rationale is supported by the model’s own generated 3D graph, aiming to filter out “correct by language shortcut” cases.
- Intervention-based diagnosis: compare performance when the model is given ground-truth structural graphs versus its self-predicted graphs, attributing errors to perception vs reasoning.
- Dataset pipeline: 1,162 single-view static scenes from nuScenes and ScanNet++, strict visibility filtering (occlusion/truncation/pixel-size thresholds), diversity filtering to reduce redundancy, and numeric IDs in the master 3D graph to avoid textual leakage.
summary_en.experiments:
Confirmed from the provided full-text excerpt:
- Scale: 1,162 scenes and 9,839 questions, balanced 1:1 indoor/outdoor.
- Reported qualitative finding: proprietary models show strong latent reasoning but inaccurate metric estimation and poor utilization of their own structural representations; open-source models differ (details not visible in the truncated excerpt).
The excerpt does not include the full experimental tables (model list, exact scores, intervention deltas). Those need verification in the main experiment section/appendices before citing numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the framing: structural spatial perception vs semantic recognition, and why standard VQA is confounded by priors.
- Focus on the evaluation protocol: dual-task design, the cross-task consistency metric, and the ground-truth vs self-predicted graph intervention.
- Skim the dataset construction/filters to understand the noise ceiling and what is controlled.
- If you want pretraining implications, look for error breakdowns: metric scale/distance estimation vs “has structure but can’t use it”, which maps to whether pretraining should include explicit geometric tokens or structural alignment losses.

recommendation.en: Read the diagnostic protocol and oracle intervention; it is useful for VLM spatial error attribution, not as another model ranking table.
